items.title: Lawrence Duhé Interview, 1957-06-09
items.q: I think Barney Bigard uses what they call the French embouchure

ctx.x: In other words, you have better lip control when you use the lip.

Yeah. Well, you know, you need some repair. Some players, I know, put their upper teeth down there, and others, I think Barney Bigard uses what they call the French embouchure, putting both lips. Yeah, I think so, yeah. Oh, you advise that, putting both lips together?
Yeah, because you can, you can, if you have the slur, you can make that, what they call the lip slur. Lip slur. If you use the teeth.
